test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 28 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: What is the best option for a woman who is about to give birth?

options.text: Adequate rest and nutritional intake for one week before delivery
Hire a certified nurse to assist with delivery
Surgery to remove the baby (caesarean section)
Delivery in a hospital with proper equipment

solution:
The correct answer is __**Delivery in a hospital with proper equipment**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **​Hospitals are equipped with medical professionals and facilities **to handle normal and complicated deliveries,
 
• It **ensures the safety of both the mother and the baby.**
 
• Delivery in a hospital provides access to emergency interventions, such as a caesarean section if necessary, and postnatal care for the mother and newborn.
 
• **The ultimate choice should align with the woman’s health, pregnancy conditions, and professional medical advice.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A woman who has just given birth to a baby is termed, Puerpera.
 
• Primigravida is a woman who has conceived pregnancy for the first time.
 
• Parturient is the woman who is about to give birth.
 
• Primipara is a woman who is giving birth for the first time
 
• In humans, the term gravidity refers to the number of times a woman is pregnant.
 
• The term gravida can be used to refer a pregnant women
 
• A Nulligravida woman is one who has never been pregnant
 
• A Multigravida is a woman who has been pregnant more than on times
 
• Parity is referred to the number of times the woman has carried the pregnancy for 20 weeks
